purpose: Explicit visual approval/rejection of a hash-pinned sanitized benchmark derivative. Candidate generation alone never authorizes model input.
approval_gate: The source SHA-256 must exactly match the verified source hash used to generate the candidate.
The sanitized pixel and PNG SHA-256 values must exactly match the generated candidate under review.
All required approval checks must be true before decision=approved is valid.
Model/hybrid reviews must record model ID and revision.
An approval applies only to the exact reviewed derivative hashes and becomes stale if source or derivative hashes change.
Rejected/revise candidates remain blocked and their failure notes are retained as negative/failure evidence.
Raw or sanitized image bytes are not required in Git; metadata and hashes are sufficient for durable approval state.
model_input_rule: Only an exact candidate with a valid explicit approved review may become sanitized_asset_status=approved and model_input_allowed=true.
